name: TOBB University of Economics & Technology
englishBachelors: TOBB ETÜ states its language of education is 70% Turkish and 30% English; no fully English degree was confirmed.
notes: Scope not set: TOBB ETÜ's 21 undergraduate programmes (2026-27 international quotas shown) are described as 70% Turkish and 30% English, with English preparatory class compulsory for most. Pages checked do not say whether any degree is fully English-taught, so no English-taught first-year degree is confirmed or ruled out. Ask the International Student Office.
IB: the international application form (PDF) sets a minimum grade of 28 for IB diplomas. No Course Results route, subject rule or IB English exemption was found.
Dates: no 2027 application dates found on the pages checked.
Tuition (undated page): USD 16,500 a year (Medicine USD 23,100); merit scholarships of 25%, 50% or 75% off tuition only, described as selective.

sources.title: Undergraduate programmes, quotas and language of education
